audience: marketing and support teams that run chatbot flows and tag subscribers in ManyChat

useCases.title: Find a subscriber and read their details
useCases.text: Search subscribers by name, then read one subscriber's tags, custom field values and subscription status.

useCases.title: Find subscribers by a custom field
useCases.text: List the custom fields of the page, then find up to 100 subscribers whose field equals a value.

useCases.title: Tag or untag a subscriber
useCases.text: List the page tags, then add a tag to a subscriber or remove a tag from a subscriber.

useCases.title: Start a flow for one subscriber
useCases.text: List the flows, then start one for a subscriber. The subscriber gets the flow's real messages.

useCases.title: Set a custom field value
useCases.text: Set one custom field value on one subscriber.
